name: Statistics Major

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Once a STAT course has been completed with a grade of C- or higher, STAT courses that are prerequisites to this course may not be taken for further credit without permission of the department.

sections.title: Computing Recommendation
sections.note: Experience with a high level programming language is recommended by the start of the second year.

sections.title: Accreditation of Courses
sections.note:
The Statistical Society of Canada has accredited certain courses within the department for partial fulfillment of the educational requirements for the associate statistician (AStat) designation.
The list of accredited courses is available at https://ssc.ca/sites/default/files/imce/2021_sfu_-_courses-sfu-summary-2021_1.pdf .
Please contact the department for details.
Further information on the professional statistician (PStat) and associate statistician (AStat) designations is available at https://www.ssc.ca/en/accreditation .

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete 120 units, including the lower division, upper division, and additional upper division requirements specified below.

requirements.title: One of MATH 150, MATH 151, MATH 154, MATH 157

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: 12 units in upper division STAT courses from Lists A and B (including a minimum of two courses from List A).

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Nine units in additional upper division ACMA, MACM, MATH, RISK or STAT courses from Lists A and B. Lists: List A.

sections.note:
STAT courses (STAT 360 in particular) and MACM 316 are recommended.
For students who wish to seek accreditation with the Statistical Society of Canada, STAT 410 and STAT 430 are recommended.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must complete 12 additional upper division units to satisfy university requirements.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Any upper division non-STAT courses or STAT courses from Lists A and B above may be used to complete these units.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
